feed.title: Jim Cramer Breaks Down P/E Multiples Explaining Why NVIDIA (NVDA) Looks Cheaper Than ServiceNow
feed.summary: Jim Cramer highlighted on Mad Money that despite its higher nominal share price, NVIDIA (NVDA) is cheaper than ServiceNow (NOW) when considering their P/E multiples, both current and forward-looking. He explained that NVIDIA's lower P/E ratio, despite its phenomenal growth, is attributed by some to beliefs that its numbers are peaking or a pause in data center spending due to political opposition. Cramer vehemently disagreed with these criticisms, emphasizing the importance of P/E multiples over nominal stock prices for valuation.
